## Overview

The `muppet` package executes Measurement and Uncertainty Preserving
ParamETric (MUPPET) modeling. MUPPET is a modular approach to model
fitting, using Bayesian approaches to modeling and estimation. Models
and analyses are conceived of in terms of fragments. Each may be fit to
data or analyzed, possibly conditional on antecedent fragments. In that
case, the results from the antecedent fragments are carried forward to
those that depend on them.

## Installation

You can install the current public version of `muppet` from GitHub. It
depends on other packages for certain fuctionality. `muppet` uses
functions that are part of the `mcmcplots` package, developed by S.
McKay Curtis, to plot results from the chains. However, `mcmcplots` is
no longer availabe on CRAN. A verion of `mcmcplots` may be installed
from GitHub, and then `muppet` can also be installed from GitHub. This
may be done as follows:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")  # if you don't have remotes installed

# Install mcmcplots from maintained fork
remotes::install_github("Roy-Levy/mcmcplots")

# Then install muppet
remotes::install_github("Roy-Levy/muppet_pub")
```

## Examples

The [Examples and
Tips](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/articles/index.html) page
has some examples and explanations of some of the basic functionality.

## Contact

Have questions or suggestions for features? Found a bug? Please contact

# Package index

## Main Function

- [`MUPPET.modular()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/MUPPET.modular.md)
  : MUPPET Analysis

## Internal Functions

- [`MUPPET.model.checking()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/MUPPET.model.checking.md)
  : MUPPET Model Checking
- [`df_to_mcmc_list()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/df_to_mcmc_list.md)
  : Converts a dataframe to an mcmc.list object
- [`mcmcplot.mod()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/mcmcplot.mod.md)
  : Plot MCMC draws
- [`model.checking.plot()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/model.check.plots.md)
  [`model.checking.cor.plot()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/model.check.plots.md)
  [`model.checking.res.cor.plot()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/model.check.plots.md)
  [`model.checking.fit.plot()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/model.check.plots.md)
  [`ppp.plot()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/model.check.plots.md)
  : MUPPET Model Checking Plotting Functions
- [`pairwise.correlation()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/pairwise.correlation.md)
  : Process Pairwise Correlations
- [`residual.cor.reorder()`](https://roy-levy.github.io/muppet_pub/reference/residual.cor.reorder.md)
  : Process Residual Correlations
